summary: Full backend + frontend regression for UrbanisAI. Backend: 22/22 pytest passing (auth, catalog/regulations/suppliers, project CRUD, dashboard, all 6 AI agents including live Gemini 3.1 Pro via THOT/IRIS/LYRA and data-gap flags). Frontend: full 4-step workflow validated end-to-end via Playwright — login, dashboard stats + presets + manual create + delete, site validation (compliant SITE APPROVED, flood/protected HARD VETO disabling proceed, determinism confirmed), design DnD (3 modules dropped, live totals € 53,520 / 2,240 kg CO2e / 56 m² updated correctly), AI Formulation Run-Sequence with LYRA completing in ~60s and KAEL citations + TERRA suppliers rendering, Project Summary + client-side PDF (Nordic_Modular_Quad_dossier.pdf downloaded), step-indicator nav-step-1..4 navigation, Local Sourcing radius/type filters + Connect toast.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description / aria-describedby — a11y console warning (non-blocking).

action_items: Optional: add <DialogDescription> to New Project modal to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py uses os.environ['JWT_SECRET'] directly — good, no default. bcrypt hashes generated fresh (start with $2b$). seed_admin correctly updates password if changed.
server.py projects endpoints correctly project away Mongo _id via projection.
SiteValidationPage validatePolygon is fully deterministic (turf booleanIntersects) — confirmed by identical metrics on repeated preset clicks.
DesignCostingPage uses debounced (500ms) PUT /api/projects for design persistence — acceptable, but note that if user navigates away within 500ms the save may not fire.
AiFormulationPage runAll iterates sequentially — matches spec; correctly awaits each agent so LYRA sees prior results in DB.
ProjectSummaryPage jsPDF client-side generation works and produces named file.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ prefixed projects during tests, cleaned up via DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 AI agents work including live Gemini calls; LYRA typically completes within 45–60s after run-sequence. If retesting, allow up to 3 minutes for the full agent chain. DnD via Playwright drag_and_drop works reliably on this app (HTML5 native). data-testids exist for palette-<id>, grid-cell-<n>, placed-<id>, material-select-<n>, run-<agent>-btn, agent-card-<id>, nav-step-1..4, preset-*, radius-*, type-*, supplier-*, connect-*.
